description.zh: Windows 正在放什么，带播放 / 暂停、上一首和下一首 —— 还有一条实时的音量折线
description.en: What Windows is playing, with play/pause, previous and next — plus a live trace of how loud it is

help.zh: 关掉就只留曲名和按钮 —— 有些播放器根本不给总时长。
help.en: Off keeps just the title and the buttons — some players report no duration at all.

help.zh: 底部那条波浪线。关掉之后那块地方还给按钮，也停止采样。
help.en: The wavy line at the bottom. Off gives that space back to the controls and stops sampling.

help.zh: 多久问一次 Windows 现在在放什么。切换播放器会在下一拍被发现。
help.en: How often to ask Windows what is playing. App switches are caught on the next poll.

title.zh: Windows 放什么它就显示什么
title.en: It follows whatever Windows is playing

items.zh: 它读的是系统媒体会话，所以 Spotify、浏览器里的一个标签页、本地播放器都是一个样子。
items.en: It reads the system media session, so Spotify, a browser tab and a local player all appear the same way.

items.zh: 播放 / 暂停、上一首、下一首都作用在那个会话上 —— 不是某一个特定的应用。
items.en: Play / pause, previous and next act on that session — not on one particular app.

items.zh: 卡片上显示曲名、歌手和专辑，还有在放它的那个应用。
items.en: The card shows the track, the artist and album, and the app that is playing it.

items.zh: 上一首 / 下一首是灰的，说明那个播放器自己说不能切歌 —— 不是组件卡住了。
items.en: A greyed-out previous or next means that player says it cannot skip — not that the widget is stuck.

title.en: The wavy line is how loud it is

items.zh: 它采的是扬声器此刻在响的声音，所以游戏、视频也能让它动，不只是上面那首歌。
items.en: It taps what your speakers are playing right now, so it moves with any sound — a game or a video too, not just the track above.

items.zh: 它只留一个数字：不录音、不存、也不往外发。
items.en: It only keeps a number: no audio is recorded, stored or sent anywhere.

items.zh: 没声音就是贴着基线的一条平线。那是诚实的读数，不是坏了。
items.en: Nothing playing means a flat line on the baseline. That is the honest reading, not a fault.

items.zh: 没有声音设备、或者设备被别的程序占着，同样是平线 —— 组件每两秒重试一次。
items.en: No sound device, or one held by another app, also gives a flat line — the widget retries every two seconds.

items.zh: 一点图标就翻；播放器不同意的话，下一拍轮询会把它纠正回来。
items.en: A click flips the icon at once; the next poll corrects it if the player disagreed.

items.zh: 等两秒图标才变，看着就是按钮坏了 —— 所以它不等。
items.en: Waiting two seconds for the icon to change reads as a broken button, so it does not wait.

items.zh: 播放器不报时长的，把「显示进度条」关掉 —— 一条永远不动的槽比没有更糟。
items.en: Turn Show progress bar off if your player reports no length — a bar that never moves is worse than none.

items.zh: 两拍之间由本地插值往前推，所以它滑得很顺，又不用每秒去问 Windows。
items.en: It is interpolated locally between polls, so it slides smoothly without asking Windows every second.

items.zh: 不支持拖动跳转：系统媒体会话并不是哪儿都暴露这个能力。
items.en: Seeking is not supported: the system media session does not expose it everywhere.

items.zh: 那不是错误。没开播放器时卡片写「没有在播放」，按钮变灰。
items.en: That is not an error. With no player open the card says Nothing playing and greys the buttons out.

items.zh: 打开播放器后，下一拍就能看到它 —— 给它一点时间。
items.en: Opening a player is picked up on the next poll, so give it a moment.

items.zh: 卡片多久问一次 Windows 在放什么。切播放器要等下一拍，间隔长了就会慢半拍。
items.en: How often the card asks Windows what is playing. App switches are caught on the next poll, so a long interval lags.

items.zh: 默认 2 秒，短到眼睛察觉不出来，又不会太费。
items.en: The default is 2 seconds, which is below what the eye notices and still cheap.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：空态、按钮标题、提示行和属性面板跟着界面语言走，换语言当场重画。歌名和歌手是系统给的，不翻。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the empty state, button titles, hints and the inspector follow the interface language and repaint on a switch. Track and artist come from the system and are not translated.

changes.zh: 从「正在播放」改名成「音乐」，id 也换成了 lattice.music。
changes.en: Renamed from Now Playing to Music, with the id lattice.music.

changes.zh: 新增：底部一条音量折线，像心电图 —— 它跟着扬声器里所有的声音走。
changes.en: New: a sound-level trace along the bottom, like an ECG — it follows whatever your speakers are playing.

changes.zh: 卡片长高了，底部的布局不再挤到没地方放。
changes.en: The card is taller and the layout no longer runs out of room at the bottom.

changes.zh: 播放器名清理过了：Spotify.exe 现在显示成 Spotify。
changes.en: The player name is cleaned up: Spotify.exe now reads Spotify.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：读系统媒体会话，带播放 / 暂停、上一首和下一首。
changes.en: First release: read the system media session, with play / pause, previous and next.

changes.zh: 进度条在本地插值，不用每秒去问 Windows 也能往前走。
changes.en: Progress bar interpolated locally, so it moves without polling Windows every second.

changes.zh: 按钮按下去当场翻转，再由下一拍轮询校正。
changes.en: Buttons flip immediately and are corrected by the next poll.
